chats.answer:
For a garage-mounted pressure washer with a hose reel, I'd narrow it down to Giraffe Tools Grandfalls Pro, Grandfalls Plus, and a custom Active pressure washer setup.

The biggest decision is whether you want an all-in-one unit with an automatic retracting hose or a higher-performance, more serviceable system with a separate hose reel.

Active 2.3 pressure washer + separate hose reel

2.3 GPM working flow · Separate pump and reel · Modular installation

Excellent for frequent vehicle washing and foam cannons. More installation work, but individual components can be upgraded.

Best budget / compact garage

Giraffe Tools Grandfalls G20 Pro

65-ft retractable hose · Swiveling wall bracket · 1,900 PSI rated

$289.99

A practical choice for smaller driveways and occasional car washing without spending $400 or more.

Which one would I buy?

For a typical two-car garage, I'd choose the Grandfalls Pro if you want a clean, permanent installation with minimal setup. Its 100-ft retractable hose is particularly convenient, and independent testing supports its ease of use.

If you're primarily washing cars several times a week, I'd lean toward the Active 2.3 with a separate wall-mounted reel. Water flow is especially important for rinsing and foam-cannon performance, and a modular setup gives you more flexibility.

One caution: manufacturers often advertise maximum PSI and GPM separately. Those figures generally aren't achieved simultaneously. Compare rated working performance instead.

Before purchasing, make sure you have a nearby water supply, a GFCI-protected outlet, and a suitable wall-mounting surface.
